subject: Marketplace tax routing + credit memo process for co-sell listings
messages:
From: MarketplaceOps AWS <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T09:14:00Z
Subject: Tax paperwork & invoice entity for Acme co-sell listing

Hi Hannah,

We're finalizing the listing for Acme Analytics on the AWS Marketplace (co-sell tagered). To finish the onboarding we need two things: 1) the billing/legal entity that should appear on AWS invoices (for marketplace remittance), and 2) the correct tax form for that entity (W-9 if US entity, W-8BEN-E for non-US).

A couple of nuances to confirm so we route invoices correctly:
- If Redwood is listed as the marketplace "publisher" and captures payment, AWS will issue the invoice to Redwood's designated billing entity and remit to you per your marketplace payout schedule.
- If Acme wants to be the billed entity (rare), we need a reseller/ISV agreement and tax paperwork from Acme.
- For EU-based usage, VAT reverse-charge may apply — we'll need a VAT number and operating country.

Can you confirm which entity to use and attach the completed tax form? Also flag if you want split invoices (customer invoice + partner commission) — this affects how credit memos are handled later.

Thanks,
Laura (Marketplace Ops)
AWS Marketplace

Attachment: marketplace_onboarding_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: MarketplaceOps AWS <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Tax paperwork & invoice entity for Acme co-sell listing

Laura,

Thanks — quick answers below and forwarding to finance and legal for final signoff.

Short answers:
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US EIN on file). We will act as the marketplace publisher and capture payment.
- Tax form: attaching a signed W-8BEN-E for our sandbox/legal test entity (we'll follow up with the corporate W-9 if needed).
- Split invoices: Preferred approach is consolidated monthly invoice from AWS to Redwood, then Redwood issues partner remits to Acme (we typically do partner payouts outside the marketplace). However, for co-sell deals where Acme requires direct invoicing, we can do a reseller flow (needs SOW + reseller addendum).

Notes/questions for you/marketplace team: how are credit memos for refunds handled in each flow (marketplace issued vs. publisher-issued)? Need SLA on credit memo timing so our finance team can close periods.

Attaching: signed_w8ben_2026.pdf; SOW-Redwood-COSELL-v2.pdf

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Principal Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: signed_w8ben_2026.pdf (signed stub)

From: GCP Partner Billing <partner-billing@gcp-partner.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-02T14:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Tax paperwork & invoice entity for Acme co-sell listing

Hi Hannah — looping in GCP side since the customer will be engaging across clouds. Quick notes from GCP billing:

- GCP issues a consolidated monthly invoice to the billing account owner. If Redwood is the billing account owner, GCP will invoice Redwood and we expect Redwood to handle partner revenue share/cut.
- For refunds/credit memos: GCP issues credit memos back to the billed entity; processing time is typically 30–60 days depending on the reason. If Redwood needs to pass credits to Acme immediately, you may need to issue an internal credit memo/sales adjustment to Acme and reconcile when GCP issues the marketplace credit.
- Tax forms: same W-9/W-8 guidance. For EU VAT, GCP supports reverse-charge on the invoice when the customer's VAT number is provided.

We can provide a sample invoice CSV that shows the fields (entity, tax amounts, VAT number). Attaching invoice_sample_marketplace.csv.

— Priya
GCP Partner Billing Team

Attachment: invoice_sample_marketplace.csv (stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-03T09:08:00Z
Subject: RE: Tax paperwork & invoice entity for Acme co-sell listing

Thanks for the context. A few internal finance items to confirm before we finalize:

1) Entity on marketplace invoice: Redwood Inference, Inc. (use EIN: 12-3456789). That's the easiest for month-end reconciliation.
2) VAT handling: if the usage is billed in EU and Acme provides VAT ID, we will accept reverse-charge. Please confirm region/country for Acme's deployments.
3) Credit memo process we prefer:
   - Marketplace issues credit memo to Redwood.
   - Redwood posts a corresponding payable to Acme and issues partner credit within 30 days of receiving marketplace credit.
   - If Acme requires faster credit, we can issue an internal credit and reconcile on next payout, but need a written request per deal (controls).

Please confirm whether Acme requires invoice entity to be Acme (we'll need a reseller addendum + Acme W-9). If not, we'll proceed with Redwood as billed entity.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
Finance Ops

Attachment: None

From: maria.ortiz@acme-analytics.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-04T15:31:00Z
Subject: Re: Tax paperwork & invoice entity for Acme co-sell listing

Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for the clear options. Acme prefers:
- Redwood to be the billed entity on the marketplace invoice (simpler for our procurement).
- We will provide VAT number if usage is EU-based; for US purchases we only need the final customer line on the invoice for internal allocation.
- Regarding credits: Acme prefers direct credit applied to our account (rather than waiting for Redwood remittance). If the marketplace issues the credit to Redwood, can Redwood auto-apply it to Acme's next month invoice? That would be fine.

One operational ask: if a credit memo is >$50k we require a joint confirmation (email or signed notice) before Redwood issues a customer-level credit — helps our auditors.

Happy to sign the reseller addendum if needed, but not necessary if Redwood remains the billed entity.

— Maria Ortiz
VP, GTM Partnerships
Acme Analytics

Attachment: acme_vat_certificate.pdf (if applicable)

From: MarketplaceOps AWS <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, maria.ortiz@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-12-05T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Tax paperwork & invoice entity for Acme co-sell listing

Thanks everyone — confirming the agreed approach:

- Marketplace will list Redwood Inference, Inc. as the billed/publisher entity and issue consolidated monthly invoices to Redwood.
- For EU transactions, we'll include VAT fields and honor reverse-charge when Acme provides VAT ID.
- Credit memos will be issued to Redwood. AWS will process marketplace credit memos within 30 days of credit approval; exceptions documented case-by-case.
- Redwood to apply credits to Acme per your internal policy; we note the >$50k joint confirmation requirement and will include that in the ticketing metadata so Marketplace ops and Redwood finance both get alerts.

Next steps:
1) Hannah to upload corporate W-9 to DocuSign link so AWS can finalize tax status.
2) Marissa to confirm the EIN and provide any reseller addendum if Acme later requests direct invoicing.
3) Marketplace to open a credit-memo SLA ticket for the account (we'll send the ticket ID once created).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABC-REDWOOD-W8
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/3421

— Laura
Marketplace Ops | AWS
